events.name: users update own profile
events.statement: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "users update own profile" ON public.profiles

events.name: users update own profile
events.statement:
CREATE POLICY "users update own profile" ON public.profiles
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (id = auth.uid())
  WITH CHECK (
    id = auth.uid()
    AND (
      tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (
        SELECT p.tenant_id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = auth.uid()
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.tenants t
        WHERE t.id = profiles.tenant_id AND t.owner_user_id = auth.uid()
      )
    )
  )
